en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The slave sees the hair and the leg of his mistress’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a slave’s looking at the hairs and leg of his mistress. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
